title: Cost allowances ledger
description: One entry per free-tier allowance a deployed service relies on. Every figure must trace back to a real, current pricing/docs page via source_url.

metric.description: Which allowance of the service this entry describes, e.g. 'active_cpu_time', 'storage'. A service can have several entries, one per metric.

unit.description: The unit the allowance is measured in, e.g. 'hours/month', 'GB/project'.

source_url.description: The exact pricing/docs page this figure was read from.

checked_on.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) this figure was verified against source_url.

note.description: Optional context: caveats, exact wording from the source, or how the figure was derived.
